settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous animal-rescue scenes. Animal count, cage state, gate state, rope and food props persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP07 — สวนสัตว์หลุดกรง
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าไปในสวนสัตว์เกมหลังประตูกรงหลายจุดเปิดผิดปกติ ต้องช่วยลูกแพนด้า กระต่าย และนกกลับพื้นที่ปลอดภัย ซ่อมประตูหลัก และเปิดทางกลับเมื่อสัตว์ทุกตัวปลอดภัย
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous rescue story. Exact brother identities fixed. Animal positions and enclosure states persist; rescued animals cannot reappear loose later.

scenes.title: ประตูเปิดค้าง
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive at bright blocky zoo entrance; one enclosure gate hangs open ahead.
scenes.mainAction: older brother notices open gate and animal tracks

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: มีสัตว์ออกมาแน่ๆ

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, open gate and small tracks, no labels/UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Gentle push to tracks. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand beside open gate; tracks lead toward bamboo garden.

scenes.title: ตามรอยเท้า
scenes.continuityStartState: Tracks begin at open gate and continue into bamboo path.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother follows tracks around one bend

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: รอยไปทางนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same tracks visibly continue, brothers walking together.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low tracking along footprints then up to brothers. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stop at bend; one small blocky panda cub visible beside bamboo; entrance gate no longer in frame but remains open behind path.

scenes.title: ลูกแพนด้า
scenes.continuityStartState: Panda cub beside bamboo; brothers a few steps away.
scenes.mainAction: older brother kneels and offers bamboo leaf to guide panda

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: มานี่นะ เดี๋ยวพากลับ

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers; one panda cub only. Older kneels with bamboo leaf; younger stays behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium gentle shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Panda cub follows older brother; both brothers turn toward panda enclosure path.

scenes.title: พาแพนด้ากลับ
scenes.continuityStartState: Panda follows older brother; younger walks beside them toward enclosure.
scenes.mainAction: they guide panda through its enclosure gate

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เข้าไปแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same panda enters enclosure once; brothers remain outside. Gate initially open.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear three-quarter follow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Panda safely inside enclosure; gate closes and stays closed; brothers outside; rabbit tracks visible toward meadow.

scenes.title: กระต่ายวิ่งหนี
scenes.continuityStartState: Panda enclosure closed behind; rabbit tracks lead to meadow.
scenes.mainAction: one small rabbit hops across path and pauses under bench

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เจออีกตัวแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers; exactly one rabbit visible under bench, no panda loose.
scenes.videoPrompt: Gentle pan following rabbit to bench. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Rabbit remains under bench; younger crouches nearby; older stands behind holding small carrot from feed basket.

scenes.title: ล่อด้วยแครอท
scenes.continuityStartState: Rabbit under bench; older holds one carrot; younger crouched nearby.
scenes.mainAction: older places carrot on ground leading toward rabbit pen

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ค่อยๆ ล่อไป

scenes.imageDescription: Same rabbit and carrot prop. Older places carrot on path; younger backs away slowly.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low animal-level shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Rabbit follows carrot toward pen entrance; carrot still in older hand just ahead of rabbit; brothers move slowly with it.

scenes.title: กระต่ายปลอดภัย
scenes.continuityStartState: Rabbit following carrot at pen entrance.
scenes.mainAction: older guides rabbit inside and younger closes gate
scenes.imageDescription: Rabbit enters pen once; younger closes plain gate; carrot no longer needed.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium side shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Rabbit safely inside closed pen; panda remains secured elsewhere; bird feathers lead toward aviary roof.

scenes.title: นกบนหลังคา
scenes.continuityStartState: Feathers lead from rabbit pen toward aviary courtyard.
scenes.mainAction: brothers look up and see one colorful bird perched on low roof edge

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: อยู่ข้างบนนั่น

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers, exactly one bird on roof edge, open aviary door below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Tilt from feathers to bird. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bird stays perched; younger notices coil of soft rope and ladder beside wall.

scenes.title: ขึ้นบันได
scenes.continuityStartState: Bird perched; ladder and soft rope beside wall.
scenes.mainAction: older steadies ladder while younger climbs two steps with rope loop

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: จับบันไดไว้ครับ

scenes.imageDescription: Same ladder, bird and brothers. Older holds ladder base; younger climbs safely.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side shot across ladder height. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger near roof edge but still on ladder; older steadying below; bird remains calm on perch.

scenes.title: พานกลง
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger near roof edge, older holding ladder, bird perched.
scenes.mainAction: younger offers forearm perch; bird steps onto it

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: มาเกาะตรงนี้

scenes.imageDescription: Same bird steps gently onto younger forearm; no extra birds. Older remains below.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close gentle action. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bird perched on younger forearm; younger starts descending; older still holds ladder.

scenes.title: กลับเข้ากรงนก
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger safely on ground with bird on forearm; aviary door open.
scenes.mainAction: younger walks to aviary and lets bird hop inside

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ดีมาก อาริ

scenes.imageDescription: Same bird moves from younger arm into aviary. Older beside him. Door remains open during entry.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bird safely inside; aviary door closes; all three rescued animals now secured; brothers notice main zoo gate mechanism still broken.

scenes.title: ซ่อมประตูหลัก
scenes.continuityStartState: All animals secured; brothers arrive at broken main gate mechanism.
scenes.mainAction: older aligns loose gear while younger holds bracket

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: จับตรงนี้ไว้

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers working on one loose gear and bracket; no random tools appear.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close teamwork shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Gear reseated; younger still holding bracket; one plain lever ready to test.

scenes.title: ทดสอบประตู
scenes.mainAction: younger pulls lever and main gate closes correctly

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ใช้ได้แล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same repaired gear. Lever pulled once; main gate closes smoothly and stays closed.
scenes.videoPrompt: Lever-to-gate pan. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Main gate secured; rescue indicator glows plain green; return portal pedestal activates nearby.

scenes.title: เช็กสัตว์
scenes.continuityStartState: Main gate repaired; all enclosures secured; portal pedestal active.
scenes.mainAction: brothers look toward secured enclosures and confirm everything calm

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ทุกตัวปลอดภัยแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same zoo. Panda, rabbit and bird visible only inside their correct enclosures, no loose animals.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow arc across secured enclosures back to brothers. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand beside active return portal pedestal; portal begins opening.

scenes.title: ทางกลับ
scenes.continuityStartState: Portal begins opening beside brothers; all animal states remain secured.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother waves once toward enclosures

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: บ๊ายบายทุกตัว

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers and opening portal. Animals remain inside enclosures.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium shot with portal glow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal fully open; both face it side-by-side.

scenes.title: ภารกิจกู้ภัยสำเร็จ
scenes.continuityStartState: Both side-by-side facing open portal; zoo secured behind.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: กลับกันเถอะ

scenes.imageDescription: Same canonical brothers enter one portal together; enclosures and gate stay secured behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear follow into portal. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Portal closes after both pass; rescue state preserved; episode complete.
